def transform(grid):
    out = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        expanded = []
        for j, value in enumerate(row):
            expanded.extend([value] * (2 if j in (0, len(row) - 1) else 1))
        out.extend([expanded[:] for _ in range(2 if i in (0, len(grid) - 1) else 1)])
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
